summary: AI-Driven Learning Dashboard: React frontend dashboard where Summary and Quiz are populated from an ActivePieces webhook response after file upload, and Ask AI uses the same webhook on-demand but with a different action to fetch only ai_answer. No database/Supabase persistence; UI updates from local state without refresh. All backend interactions via POST.
architectural_notes: Backend is ActivePieces automation; frontend integrates via webhooks (URLs provided later).
Summary/Quiz/AI Answer must be derived strictly from backend responses; no DB/Supabase persistence; store in local React state.
Ask AI requests must include user_question plus uploaded_notes/context.
Frontend will use one webhook URL for both flows; requests must include an action/type field so backend can route: file upload => summary+quiz, Ask AI => ai_answer.

existing_features.title: Implement a configuration mechanism for two external ActivePieces webhook URLs (Endpoint A for file processing; Endpoint B for Ask AI) without hardcoding them. Use environment variables (e.g., VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL) and show a clear, user-facing error in English if either URL is missing when an action is triggered.

Build the main dashboard page that updates purely from in-memory React state (no database/Supabase) and renders Summary + Quiz immediately after a successful file-upload response without page refresh.

Implement the file upload flow that sends a POST request to Endpoint A with the uploaded notes file and parses the JSON response containing a summary string and a quiz_array. Store summary and quiz_array in local state for rendering.
Render the Summary section as a clean, readable container that displays the summary string from the Endpoint A response.

Implement the Interactive Quiz component that consumes quiz_array items shaped like {"question": string, "options": ["A","B","C","D"], "correct_answer": string}. Display questions in a top-to-bottom list with A/B/C/D as vertical buttons and provide per-question answer validation feedback.
Add quiz management controls: a View toggle to show/hide the quiz list and a Delete action that removes the quiz content from local state immediately.

Implement the "Ask AI" module that uses Endpoint B as a separate, on-demand POST request. The request must include user_question plus the uploaded_notes context (derived from the previously uploaded file content or stored text context), and the response must include only ai_answer which is then rendered in the UI.

Add loading and reset behaviors for Ask AI: show an English loading state (exact text: "AI is thinking...") while awaiting Endpoint B; include a Delete/Clear button that clears the ai_answer and resets the input field immediately.

Create a coherent minimalist, modern, responsive visual theme (not blue/purple) and apply it consistently across Auth screens and the Dashboard (typography, spacing, card styles, buttons, states for success/error/loading).

Implement authentication UX using Internet Identity (supported on the Internet Computer) instead of username/password, Google OAuth, email verification, and password reset. Provide a single sign-in/sign-out flow and gate the dashboard behind authentication.

Allow the app to be configured with a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload processing and Ask AI by supporting the case where VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL point to the same URL and by providing a fallback so that if only one of these environment variables is set, the app uses the configured one for both actions.

When calling the single ActivePieces webhook URL, include an explicit action discriminator in the POST request body so the external automation can route the request appropriately: file uploads must send action="process_notes" and expect {summary, quiz_array}; Ask AI must send action="ask_ai" along with user_question and uploaded_notes and expect {ai_answer}.

Update the frontend configuration documentation/template to reflect that a single webhook URL can be used for both actions, while still supporting separate URLs, and ensure all guidance is in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build React dashboard UI that populates Summary + Quiz from backend response immediately after file upload (no refresh, local state only)
Implement file upload flow that POSTs to Endpoint A and receives summary + quiz_array response
Implement Ask AI module that POSTs user_question + uploaded_notes to separate Endpoint B and displays returned ai_answer with loading + clear actions
Interactive Quiz component: parse quiz JSON, render vertical list of questions/options, validate correct/incorrect with button color feedback, plus view toggle and delete-from-state
Auth UI flows: login/signup with email verification gating activation, Google OAuth option, and forgot-password reset UI
Enforce no database persistence for summary/quiz/ai content (disconnect Supabase/DB); only use backend responses into frontend state
Support using a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload and Ask AI by sending an explicit action/type in the POST body (e.g., process_notes vs ask_ai) and parsing responses accordingly

projectName: AI-Driven Learning Dashboard UI wired to two ActivePieces webhook endpoints (POST-only, no persistence)
